topic.description: The undertaking in one sentence, in the user's language.

rationale.description: Why exactly this split into runs. Names the line between runs and justifies every dependency.

clarifications.description: Everything you cannot find out yourself and without which a run would have to guess: complete, now, in one list. The operator sees these questions once, at approval, and is never asked again. Empty only if truly nothing is open.

question.description: One question, one sentence, no jargon. Answerable without a terminal.

why.description: What would be wrong in the result if you answered it yourself.

options.description: The answers to choose from, if there are any. Empty for free input (address, price, credentials).

assumption.description: What the runs assume if the operator enters nothing. Required when blocking=false, empty when blocking=true.

blocking.description: true only if no reasonable assumption exists and a run would demonstrably work wrong without the answer, e.g. mandatory data only the operator knows. Otherwise false plus 'assumption'.

id.description: Short identifier, lowercase, only a-z0-9 and hyphen. Used by 'needs'.

cwd.description: Absolute path of the working directory. Must be one of the configured projects.

mode.description: read = no changes to existing files, only artifacts. build = change code, then run the check. free = everything allowed, no check.

effort.description: Costs money and time, not only quality, and all runs share one usage window. mode=read may go up to xhigh because that is where insight happens. mode=build gets at most high: implementing a finished finding is mechanical. max is reserved for the planner's critic and is never right in a plan.

budget_usd.description: Spending cap for this run. Passed as --max-budget-usd.

needs.description: ids of other runs in this plan that must finish first. Empty if independent.

artifacts.description: Files the run must produce, relative to cwd. In mode=read these are the only allowed write targets.

acceptance.description: Observable sentences by which the operator can tell after the run that the promised thing exists. Each names a place and an observable fact ('On /settings every account shows its bank name'), not an intention ('labels improved'). Only what this run itself can bring about. The summary later judges against exactly this list.

check.description: Shell command that must exit 0 after the run. Required for mode=build, otherwise null.

post_run.description: Shell command after a green check, e.g. regenerating an index.

personas.description: Empty when a single perspective is enough, which is the normal case: every extra persona multiplies the cost. Useful in mode=read where two viewpoints find different defects. Almost never in mode=build.

tools.description: Skills, plugins or agents this run should use. Only names from tools.json, if that file exists.

prompt.description: The complete, final prompt for this run. Contains context, rules, personas with tasks and the artifact definition.

model.description: Set only if this run needs a different model than the configured default.
